resources.string: Set up Moggcord for your Discord app.
The module is included in this app. Enable it for Discord in your existing LSPosed setup.

1. Open LSPosed and go to Modules.

2. Enable Moggcord for Android and select Discord.

3. Fully close Discord, then open it and look for Moggcord Mobile in Settings.
You can keep using the previous loader. To switch, turn it off in LSPosed before enabling this one. Keep your Discord app installed.
Turn off Moggcord Mobile Loader in LSPosed before enabling Moggcord for Android.
Open LSPosed from its notification. Setup requires an existing LSPosed installation.
